en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al A’ala Bin Al Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the nose is cut from the soft parts, so regarding it is the complete wergild; and regarding the teeth of the man is the complete wergild; and regarding his ears is the complete wergild; and the two feet, and the two eyes are at that status’.
